expectations.text: Exactly one Lenis instance is created in the app (no second smooth-scroll library, no autoRaf alongside a manual raf loop)
expectations.evidence: main.tsx wraps App in the single <SmoothScroll> (src/scroll/SmoothScroll.tsx, identical to the tested template); no other Lenis/smooth library; autoRaf:false

expectations.text: Lenis is driven by gsap.ticker (gsap.ticker.add calling lenis.raf with time*1000) and gsap.ticker.lagSmoothing(0) is set
ScrollTrigger is updated from Lenis scroll events (lenis.on('scroll', ScrollTrigger.update) or equivalent)
The CSS rule html { scroll-behavior: smooth } is removed or neutralised because it conflicts with Lenis programmatic scrolling
expectations.evidence: index.css: 'html { scroll-behavior: smooth }' removed, with comment explaining the conflict

expectations.text: In-page anchor navigation scrolls with a 72px (or header-height) offset so sections are not hidden under the fixed header
expectations.evidence: RUNTIME (Playwright, built with vite): clicking 'Pricing' lands #pricing at top=144px, not 72px. Cause: the run added 'section[id]{scroll-margin-top: var(--header-h)}' while the template also passes offset:-72 — Lenis 1.3.27 scrollTo(element) already subtracts scroll-margin-top (lenis.mjs L787-790), so the offset is applied twice.

expectations.text: Anchor navigation moves keyboard focus to the target section (e.g. tabindex=-1 + focus) or otherwise preserves accessible focus
expectations.evidence: RUNTIME: document.activeElement.id === 'pricing' after both nav and menu clicks

expectations.text: Opening the mobile menu stops scrolling (lenis.stop() or equivalent) and closing it restores scrolling (lenis.start())
expectations.evidence: App.tsx: useScrollLock(open) → lenis.stop()/start(); RUNTIME: wheel while menu open left scrollY unchanged; scrolling works after close

expectations.text: The Lenis instance and the ticker callback are cleaned up on unmount (lenis.destroy() and gsap.ticker.remove)
expectations.evidence: SmoothScroll.tsx cleanup: gsap.ticker.remove(tick); lagSmoothing restored; instance.destroy()

expectations.text: The Lenis stylesheet (lenis/dist/lenis.css) or equivalent recommended CSS is included
expectations.evidence: SmoothScroll.tsx imports 'lenis/dist/lenis.css'; RUNTIME html has class 'lenis'
